description: A ground-level photograph depicting an expansive coastal salt marsh environment. The foreground and midground consist of a relatively flat, open area with light brown earth, interspersed with patches of sparse green vegetation. On the left side of the midground, several shallow, reflective pools of water or small channels are visible. In the background, a line of dense trees or woodland rises on a slightly elevated landform. The sky is bright, with a strong light source in the upper left, causing a lens flare. The scene represents a low-lying, periodically flooded wetland habitat, characteristic of a salt marsh as described by EUNIS habitat types and Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) class 7.2.1.
